summary: Frontend-only verification of 6 requirements on ARC.LAB landing (Planes/Nutricion/Prueba). All primary requirements PASS. Elite CTA renders with white bg + arcblue text + visible animated blue ring (elite-trace rotating, confirmed via 2 transform samples), and animation is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion:reduce (animationName=none, duration=0s, transform stable across samples). Screenshot of the CTA parent confirms a subtle blue ring is visible around the button. Badge 'El más vendido' has transparent bg + arcblue text + uppercase + tracking 2.5px. CTAs Basic/Duo show exactly 'Empezar' single-line; Pro shows '✆ Empezar' (phone glyph prefix intentional for featured card per code). Nutricion band is bg-ink with white 5xl title, price 35€ in Anton white 60px, CTA 'Empezar ahora' → wa.me/34711233350. Prueba: max-w-lg lg:max-w-[42rem] classes applied; carousel next arrow navigates (image content changes; caption text is identical across athletes due to placeholder meta/team so figcaption comparison is not a reliable signal). No horizontal scroll at 1440/1024/375; CTAs single-line on 375.

issues: CTA text on Pro (featured) is '✆ Empezar' (phone glyph prefix). Task criteria states CTAs Basic/Pro/Duo devem mostrar 'exatamente Empezar' — code intentionally adds ✆ for featured (Planes.jsx line 146). Confirm if this is the desired copy or should be removed for consistency.

action_items: (Optional) Decide whether Pro CTA should include the ✆ prefix or match Basic/Duo exactly ('Empezar').
critical_code_review_comments: Prueba.jsx: All athletes share the same meta/team fallback, so figcaption text does not change on navigation — verified via image rendering that carousel does advance, but caption-based tests will falsely report no change. Consider varying athlete meta or adding an index-based data-testid for reliable test assertions.

Prueba.jsx: Parent flex container uses max-w-3xl (768px). Combined with two peek children (w-56 each), the central card never approaches the max-w-lg (512px) / lg:max-w-[42rem] (672px) constraints — rendered card width is ~384px at both 1024 and 1440. If the spec truly requires 512/672 rendered width, the parent constraint should be relaxed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Elite trace ring verified visible + rotating + disabled under reduced-motion. Do NOT rely on figcaption text to detect carousel navigation — all athletes have identical placeholder caption. Use athlete image src or ARIA slide index instead.
